title: Baatu Xel mi
intro: Musna am baat bu woyof bu am xel mu séddoo ay xelal yu weesu jamono. Nit kooku, ku am xam-xam bu xóot, jàngal na njàngale yu am solo yuy wéy di nekk làmp ci képp ku bëgga am njiit. Ndax mën nga fësal li nekk ci ginaaw kàddu yu yàgg yooyu?
clues: Yàlla may na ma ngëneel bu xóot bu jóge ci Yàlla, may gu leeral sama xol ak sama xel.
Ma wëlbatiku ci sama doom ji ma bëgg, bëgga séddoo alal ji gëna am solo ji ma am.
Ma artu leen ni, njubadi bi gëna tar mooy ñu boole seen doole ak Benn Yàlla bu dëggu bi.
Ma fàttali ni, doonte benn jiwwu mutard, buñu nëbb ci biir xeer wala ginaaw asamaan, Yàlla dina ko lim.
Maa ngi leen di jàngal ñu topp seen waajur, waaye déggal seen waajur du lu baax.
Dama jàngal nit ñi ni ñuy doxalee ci kaw suuf ak woyof, ba noppi teey seen baat; Ndaxte bruit bi gëna tar mooy yuuxu mbaam xuux yi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
